B0DB8KS8Q3.title: Aqara Smart Valve Controller T1,Matter Over Bridge, Zigbee 3.0 Hub Required
bullets: [Zigbee with Matter Support] An Aqara Zigbee 3.0 Hub is required and sold separately. The Valve Controller T1 features Matter-over-bridge support and is compatible with major third-party platforms, like Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, Samsung SmartThings, Homey, Home Assistant. An Aqara hub (except the Camera G2H Pro) and a Matter Controller for the corresponding platform are required.

[Real-time monitoring and automation] Pair it with water leak sensors for automatic shutdown when leaks are detected, ensuring safety even when you're away. Monitor valve status in real time through the Aqara Home app to prevent potential risks and enhance safety. This device does not provide safeguards against water ingress and is not suitable for outdoor installation.

[Easy installation and wide compatibility] Valve Controller T1 is a complete retrofit device, easy to install on existing valves without additional piping work. Compatible with DN15, DN20, DN25 (1/2 in, 3/4 in, 1 in) in pipe diameters and lever/butterfly handles to meet diverse needs.(Note:Different pipe sizes require different installation accessories)

[Flexible Remote Control] Control your valves remotely through the Aqara Home app or manually on-site. Enjoy the convenience and peace of mind with flexible options for managing your water from anywhere.

[Energy saving and environmental protection] The Valve Controller T1 features a 4 × AA battery power source, eliminating the need for additional wiring at the valve installation point. Designed with a low-power consumption system to extend battery life and reduce energy waste, the device can operate for up to 2 years, providing long-lasting water safety. This aligns with the energy conservation and environmental protection goals of modern households, making it an eco-friendly addition to your smart home.

B0DK5VQ29S.title: Zigbee Smart Water Shutoff Valve 3/4"
bullets: Tuya Zigbee hub required: Operates on a stable mesh network for reliable offline execution. It does not connect directly to standard Wi-Fi routers. Connects to your compatible Tuya gateway to enable smart home functionality

Automated leak protection: Stop water damage immediately by pairing this smart valve with wireless moisture detectors. The pipeline shutoff mechanism triggers within 17 seconds when any linked sensor identifies a potential flood

Solid brass construction: Engineered with heavy-duty metal and an IP55 waterproof housing for reliable indoor or outdoor main line applications. Install this DN20 3/4 inch threaded unit directly into your plumbing system

Manual override and power memory: Never lose access to your water supply during grid failures. Use the built-in rotary switch to easily open or close the mechanism by hand. Features customizable power-off memory states via the application

Remote control and schedules: While engineered primarily for emergency leak defense, this electric mechanism can also be programmed for daily garden watering based on custom time rules via the dedicated smartphone application
